purpose: Test four deliberately simple and partially unconventional closed-OHLC hypotheses without rescuing prior rejected families.

rule.long: Previous five closed M15 bars are bearish and each body <= -0.10 ATR14 of that bar; current closed M15 is bullish and closes above the previous bar midpoint.
rule.short: Previous five closed M15 bars are bullish and each body >= +0.10 ATR14 of that bar; current closed M15 is bearish and closes below the previous bar midpoint.

rule.setup: Previous four closed M15 bars have strictly alternating non-doji body signs, each absolute body >= 0.05 ATR14, and their total high-low range <= 2.00 ATR14 measured on the fourth setup bar.
rule.long: Current closed M15 closes >= setup high + 0.05 ATR14.
rule.short: Current closed M15 closes <= setup low - 0.05 ATR14.

rule.level: Nearest 1000 USD level to current M15 open using floor((open+500)/1000)*1000.
rule.long: M15 low <= level - 0.10 ATR14 and M15 close > level.
rule.short: M15 high >= level + 0.10 ATR14 and M15 close < level.
rule.ambiguity: If both directions qualify on the same bar, invalidate both.

rule.setup: For each MT5 naive calendar date, use the first four existing closed M15 bars as the opening range.
rule.window: Only the next twelve existing M15 bars after the fourth setup bar are eligible.
rule.long: The first eligible M15 close outside either side closes >= range high + 0.10 ATR14.
rule.short: The first eligible M15 close outside either side closes <= range low - 0.10 ATR14.

anti_overfit: No parameter neighbors in this cycle.
No post-result direction, month, time, volatility or year rescue.
No prospective Shadow unless a formal base passes every gate.
